A '''Searing swoop bike''' was a loud model of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]. [[Khedryn Faal]] used one and stored it aboard his [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]], the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']].
